label: first token is q/m; plus first copy-output step of L=3 sequences
explanation: Two unrelated components. (1) Sequence-start q/m detector: fires at t=0 on every sequence whose first token is q or m (precision 1.0), at a small constant magnitude (~0.08-0.14 of max; q slightly higher than m). It does not fire for q/m at later original positions except weakly (rate ~3%). (2) L=3 copy-start: at step t=4 (the step right after <DEL>, outputting original token 1) in length-3 sequences, it fires about 45% of the time and holds the largest activations (top examples are all here, up to max). These are stronger when orig(2) is r/f/h/n/x and when the sequence also starts with q/m, but those refinements cost recall. Never fires on the delimiter step or at t>=6; small residual weak activations at t=2/4 in the original phase are unexplained. Dev: P 0.84, R 0.80, F1 0.82, mass recall 0.87.
